method: Fixed question-level split, chosen before any retrieval results. Categories appear in both splits. Near-paraphrase groups Q02/Q13, Q11/Q23, and Q20/Q24 stay together.
limitations: Only 30 synthetic questions. The supplied labels were inspected for schema validation; this is a held-out query split, not a blind or unseen-policy benchmark. Freeze configuration before scoring heldout; use new held-out questions after tuning to it.
